text:
Mateo: heads-up, we've been seeing recurring Xid errors on node-gpu-eu-12, ECC counts spiking over the last 24h. 4/8 cards reporting corrected ECC and a couple uncorrectable flashes. I've opened a vendor ticket but wanted to sync on logistics before we drain.
Priya: thanks — can you paste the serials and the vendor ticket id? we'll need depot swap + customs info for EU.
Mateo: serials: SN-EU-9A12, SN-EU-9A13, SN-EU-9A14, SN-EU-9A15. Vendor ticket: VND-987654. RMA ref they gave me: RMA-2026-019. rma-bot created a tracker entry: #rma-1764987654.
Alex: do we know if vendor will do depot swap in NL or direct ship to our datacenter? last time they tried depot swap and the transit + customs took 10 days.
Sam: quick capacity note — losing those 4 cards reduces eu-west-1 GPU capacity ~12% for heavy-batch lanes. Need to consider temporary traffic shift to us-central.
Jen: I'm on shipping. Vendor emailed: "Depot swap NL (Eindhoven) or contact our partner for on-site swap." They asked for EORI and PO. Do we have a PO for this RMA? finance needs cost center.
Mateo: I attached the diag logs in the ticket — there are repeated Xid 31 traces and thermal spikes right before failures. Also firmware mismatch flagged on SN-EU-9A13 (firmware 24.0 vs fleet standard 24.2).
Priya: firmware mismatch could cause flakiness; vendor should honor swap but confirm they won't refuse if firmware differs. Alex, can you loop in the vendor AM to expedite? escalate if SLA breached.
Alex: pinging @Olya (vendor-AM) in thread and forwarding ticket. Drafted message: "We have 4 cards with uncorrectable ECC, RMA-2026-019, require depot swap in NL; provide expedited outbound label and confirm EORI handling." Should I add the PO? which cost center?
Mateo: charge to infra cloud-ops (CC: CLOU-OPS-22). No PO in system — finance approves emerg RMA without PO for hardware failures, Jen will confirm.
Jen: confirmed with finance over DM. I'll provide PO placeholder PO-000432 to vendor now. Also confirming our EORI: GB000123456789 (customer uses EU transfer paperwork). Vendor requested recipient phone + contact: Ops desk +44 20 7946 1000.
rma-bot: ticket VND-987654 status changed -> "Depot swap requested". ETA vendor response: 48h per SLA.
Sam: operational plan: schedule drain of node-gpu-eu-12 tonight 02:00 UTC, migrate running jobs, and mark cards as "quarantined" in inventory. Drain command for the oncall: ```kubectl drain node-gpu-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=30m``` then power off server, remove chassis, ship cards. After swap, run validation: ```/usr/local/bin/gpu-health-check --serial SN-EU-9A12,SN-EU-9A13,SN-EU-9A14,SN-EU-9A15 --burn 30m``` 
Mateo: note: two of the cards have vendor serial tags that don't match our asset tag mapping for node-gpu-eu-12. Inventory shows SN-EU-9A14 mapped to node-gpu-eu-18. I think vendor might have shipped wrong parts previously; we need to double-check serials on site before they accept depot return.
Olya: vendor-AM here, I see the ticket. I can push for depot swap, but NL depot will need a correct RMA manifest and proof of ownership for cross-border returns. Also, for firmware mismatch cases we sometimes need a firmware reconciliation step — vendor may reflash before sending replacement. I can ask them to waive that if you provide logs showing hardware errors.
Alex: thanks Olya. Can you ask them to pre-stage pre-flashed replacements to avoid extra turn-around on our side? Also request overnight courier pickup and tracking on the outbound.
Olya: will request pre-flash and overnight. They flagged one caveat: if depot cannot locate our asset (serial mismatch) they may hold the part; best to include photos of the tag and chassis label when sending parts.
Jen: I'll add photos to the shipment manifest and attach to the ticket. Also collecting customs invoice with declared value $0 (warranty) + RMA number to speed through customs.
Sam: runbook reminder for oncall: 1) drain node, 2) migrate jobs, 3) set node to maintenance in console, 4) power down, 5) remove cards, 6) ship with vendor label, 7) update inventory: `inv mark quarantined SN-...`, 8) monitor replacement arrival and run health-checks.
Mateo: any objections to doing the drain tonight? impact minimal — low batch windows after 01:30 UTC.
Priya: go ahead. @oncall please follow the runbook and ping here when node is drained. Also flag if vendor responds with any extra forms.
rma-bot: reminder scheduled: "drain node-gpu-eu-12 at 02:00 UTC" (automated).
Alex: I'll keep the vendor AM looped and track shipping/tracking numbers. please post tracking here once available.
Mateo: thanks everyone. I'll start the drain prep and post serial photos + logs to VND-987654. If depot swap stalls >72h escalate to Olya for AM-level SLA breach.
Jen: uploading photos now. shipment label pending from vendor.
rma-bot: ticket VND-987654 updated: vendor provided outbound tracking TRK-EU-334455 (pending pickup). ETA replacement arrival: 3 business days (subject to customs).
Alex: once replacements arrive, test on staging first before putting them into prod — we'll use the gpu-health-check burn + perf regression quick suite. If perf delta >5% revert to vendor.
Mateo: noted. I'll follow up after drain completes and post final shipping/tracking. :thumbsup:
